overview_description.description:
Fintech Galaxy is a UAE-founded financial technology platform focused on accelerating innovation in financial services through Open Banking and Open Finance infrastructure. The company enables secure collaboration between financial institutions, fintech companies, and consumers by facilitating seamless API integrations and data connectivity across the financial ecosystem.

At the core of its offering is FINX, Fintech Galaxy’s Open Finance platform, which provides secure, scalable, and stable API infrastructure that allows banks, fintechs, and other financial service providers to connect efficiently. Through FINX, the company helps organizations streamline integration processes, improve interoperability, and create more innovative digital financial products and services.

Fintech Galaxy’s platform is designed to give consumers greater control over their financial data and payments while supporting regulatory compliance and ecosystem-wide collaboration. By enabling secure data sharing and embedded financial services, the company contributes to the broader adoption of Open Banking and next-generation financial ecosystems across the Middle East and global markets.

Operating within the fintech infrastructure and API economy sectors, Fintech Galaxy generates value by supporting digital transformation initiatives for banks, financial institutions, and fintech startups seeking to build connected, customer-centric financial experiences.
